0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Orlando Magic host the Atlanta Hawks, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Magic a 55% chance to win. Orlando's injury list includes Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), along with Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Franz Wagner (shoulder soreness), Jase Richardson (back soreness), Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain), and Noah Penda (hamstring), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and has Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the Hawks won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1.
